reviews.text: Can’t say enough good things about this place. Everyone is incredibly kind and genuinely cares about your pet, the prices are great, the care is exceptionally quick, and the communication is fantastic. They don’t up charge on anything, there’s no sales tactics, they just want to genuinely help. Highly highly recommend.
I felt wonderful in this place all the employees were very professional

We didn't feel rushed and we were able to go to the exam room with Tiger. The last few places we visited did not allow us to go into the exam room. But at Dexter an Evie we could be right there with our kitty. Pricing is fair as well. We will stick with this vet for all of our furry children from now on. Definitely recommend.

Please keep your animals away from this place. The main priority here is money not care for your animals. The doctor doesn’t know anything and googles solutions rather than know them. Dr. Tran is an amazing veterinarian! She took the time to perform a thorough physical examination of my puppy, Bartolomeo, and made sure everything was clearly explained.

Once his lab results came in, she contacted me immediately. Even though the clinic was already closed for the day, she waited for me to pick up a new prescription so Bartolomeo could start his treatment right away and we wouldn’t have to delay it because of the long holiday weekend. I truly appreciated her dedication and care.

I also really appreciated Dr. Tran’s honesty. She recommended what was actually going to help Bartolomeo and did not push unnecessary additional testing or expensive procedures that were not needed at the moment. That gave me a lot of confidence in her recommendations.

The entire staff has also been wonderful—always calm, friendly, and caring with the pets. They take the time to explain medications and medical recommendations in detail and make sure you understand everything before leaving.

I’m extremely happy with the care Bartolomeo received and will definitely recommend Dr. Tran and this clinic to other pet owners. Thank you for taking such great care of him!

Rather than go into the details of my negative experience, I will simply say that I will not be returning. If you want an affordable option visit the SPCA or other animal shelters.

They took the time to answer all of my questions and made us feel welcomed from the moment we walked in. It’s clear that they truly care about both their patients and their owners. I highly recommend D&E Vet Clinic to anyone looking for compassionate, high-quality veterinary care. Thank you again for taking such great care of Layla!

As a pet parent, finding a veterinary team you can completely trust is invaluable, and I feel incredibly fortunate to have found D&E. Their professionalism, knowledge, and compassion have earned my complete confidence.

I wholeheartedly recommend D&E to anyone and everyone looking for outstanding veterinary care. If you want a team that truly cares about your furry family members, this is the place to go. Thank you, Dr. Lam, Nurse Dariana, and everyone at D&E Vet Clinic for taking such wonderful care of Nibbler, Buttercup, and Munchkin! 🫶🏻

I will be back time and time again!

Update Jul 9. Still great care, a new provider today Dr Lam, clean, kind, very happy
Dr. Tran and Nurse Sophie were such a delight, my kitten warmed up to them so fast because of how gentle and sweet they treated him. My experience here was nothing but smiles.

Brought my newly adopted cat in for the first time and had a great experience! They champion affordability which I REALLY appreciate. They listened to my concerns, gave price ranges/optional care resources based on price, and were extremely friendly/kind/gentle to my cat. I told them about my cat’s itchiness and chin acne, and they were able to provide ointment and the first dose of flea treatment in person, and that + the visit was $100. The were also very vocal about me reaching out after the visit with questions as a first time cat owner, and made me feel heard. I highly recommend!!

Update - a lot of the response to my review below is not true, which adds to insult. My dog has a history of heartworm but it was not tested, although yes I agreed to bloodwork. More medication was not recommended. "Ropiness" was never the main concern - that was me trying to report on clues that I believed could help explain the chief complaint I came in for - limping. And it should be obvious to any doctor that limping sometimes takes more than 3 steps to manifest and may not show if the dog is kept still on a table. Nor should I have to point out that the paw or wrist could be a potential source of limping (really?). The nurse described a common knee joint manual test vets often do when I asked if Xrays could show anything besides bone, when I suspected a tendon issue. The test in question was absolutely NOT done. A visual and touching his shoulder is all the exam that was done. And blaming my dog for moving during X-ray? He is over 14 and anxious.
Lastly their follow-up email said a potential explanation could be a hernia - which I told them was there and operated on 12 years ago... 12 years during which he did not limp. They said the hernia could cause a sciatic pinch - but the limp is in the front... you be the judge.

-------

I hate leaving negative reviews, but I feel compelled to share my experience.
I brought my dog in for ongoing limping and was encouraged to pay about $500 for extensive X-rays. I specifically asked whether common joint issues would also be evaluated manually, and was told the doctor would perform basic orthopedic testing as part of the exam.
Unfortunately, the doctor never physically examined my dog or performed any manual orthopedic tests. He simply recommended X-rays and then suggested seeing an orthopedic specialist.
What’s most frustrating is that despite taking 9 X-rays, they did not image the paw or wrist — one of the most plausible sources of the limp. When I asked why, instead of acknowledging a possible oversight, their response was essentially that they had been “kind enough” to include many body regions and that most clinics only image one area at a time. But that misses the point entirely.
Not having answers can happen in medicine. Failing to evaluate the most relevant area should not. My dog’s limping has worsened, and now I have to start over with a specialist after paying for diagnostics that did not properly assess the issue.
The staff was kind, and I’m sure this clinic is fine for routine care, but for more complex problems I would go elsewhere.

Nurse Jill is respectful, friendly, makes eye contact (a sign of trustworthiness and integrity) and seems to be passionate about her job. She speaks clearly and directly and has genuine concern for both animals and their humans!

Dexter and Evie Veterinary Clinic is truly the best veterinary clinic I have ever been to. Dr. Lam is an incredible veterinarian who always takes the time to listen to all of my concerns — including the frantic worrying that comes with being the mom of an almost 17-year-old cat. He makes sure I am very well informed about her health and consistently provides multiple options for treatments and preventative measures for her arthritis and kidney disease. I also really appreciate how fair and reasonable the pricing is. I never feel pressured into unnecessary testing or treatments, and I always feel that recommendations are made with Miley’s best interest in mind.

What impresses me most about this clinic, though, is the amazing veterinary technicians/nurses. Every single one of them is so kind and gentle with my Miley. They always remember her when we come in, and it’s clear how much they genuinely care about their patients. Even when Miley is in another room getting blood drawn, x-rays, vaccines, or injections, I can hear them speaking so sweetly to her — calming her nerves, reassuring her, and telling her how brave she is.

That level of compassion means so much, especially with a senior cat who gets very anxious at the vet. It is such a warm, caring, and wonderful practice, and I am so grateful for everyone there. Miley and I absolutely love this clinic!

They have always attended to our babies needs. No matter what, they take in our pets even without an appointment.  We've been going to bother of their clinics for years and we are very pleased with them!
I absolutely love the care the team at D&E gives to my cats. They are all very patient and answer my questions thoroughly, which is helpful as a first time pet owner.

It was one of the worst experiences I have ever had that I can remember, but that had nothing to do with the clinic or the staff. My life mate was sick, much sicker than I expected. When you are powerless to chance something and having a bad time, the wrong vet can make you want to rage out and destroy.

But the doctor and nurses were incredibly empathetic: rather than use that as an opportunity to render every test, drug, procedure under the moon they were frank and honest about what I was facing.

They truly cared and treated my family member with grace and respect. Thank you for that.
This is the best vet office!!! They are always so nice, take good care of my pup. They are very accommodating with times. Prices are great, especially compared to chain animal clinics

The office is clean and bright, and the staff is nice and professional. However, a puppy was brought in for an exam and the individual who brought in the puppy specifically pointed out a scabby, red ear. The vet tech relayed this to the vet, who concluded it was likely from scratching without running any tests.

Later that week another veterinarian confirmed the puppy had ringworm, Hookworm (Ancylostoma) Eggs 3+, Roundworm (Toxocara) Eggs 4+, and Cystoisospora Oocysts 2+. Very disappointed by the lack of a thorough exam and standard of care during the visit, especially given the potential health risks of these conditions to other pets and humans.
